assumptions.text: The scanned tub (UPC 3 00680 41830 1, 'Citrucel Orange', 30 oz) is SPL product NDC 0135-0089 (850 g bottle, 0135-0089-71). The SPL does not carry the UPC; the link is the product name and size on the tub.
The dose consists only of the listed ingredients and the flavors named in the SPL text (mass balance).
text_variant_attribution: the sections titled '(Citrucel Orange)' apply to manufacturedProduct 0135-0089. An SPL ties text sections to products only by their titles.
The SPL (set 9d5f2244, version 17) states the formulation of the physical sample.
The OTC statement 'contributes 60 calories' is rounded like a Nutrition Facts calorie value (21 CFR 101.9(c)(1)); no rule for OTC calorie statements exists.
Calories 'from sucrose and maltodextrin' use the general factor of 4 kcal/g for carbohydrate (21 CFR 101.9(c)(1)(i)(B)).
All calcium comes from dibasic and tricalcium phosphate, in any proportion; no other listed ingredient contains calcium.

Tricalcium phosphate has its UNII formula Ca3(PO4)2. (Food/USP 'tribasic calcium phosphate' is a variable mixture close to hydroxyapatite, which has more calcium per gram: the true phosphate mass could be lower than this bound.)
All potassium comes from potassium citrate (as the UNII monohydrate).
A 'heaping tablespoon' dose is the 19 g in the SPL's strength denominator.

notes: CITRUCEL_ORANGE: the SPL text list of inactive ingredients also names 'orange flavors (natural and artificial)', which has no structured entry or UNII in the SPL.
CITRUCEL_ORANGE: the SPL has no Nutrition Facts, so there is no declared total carbohydrate; consistency is checked by mass balance against the 19 g dose instead.
OTC inactive ingredients are listed alphabetically (21 CFR 201.66(c)(8)): no weight-order constraint is used.

variant_note: SPL set 9d5f2244 covers CITRUCEL Orange (NDC 0135-0089) and Sugar Free (0135-0090). Product facts use the manufacturedProduct with code 0135-0089; text facts use the sections titled '(Citrucel Orange)'.
